Name: Lucky Finds
Author: BelLucifer
Description:
[b]Lucky Finds[/b] adds a fun little surprise to your daily Stardew routine.
Whenever you cut grass, dig the ground, or break twigs and stones, you have a small chance to find gold coins!

[list]
[*]Small random gold rewards on everyday actions
[*]Rare jackpot rewards (up to 100g just to make it fun but not too fun that distracts from normal gameplay)
[*]Sound on jackpots
[*]100% compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6 and SMAPI 4.0+
[/list]✨ A lightweight and lore-friendly mod that rewards curiosity!

📦 Installation Instructions:
[list]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI 4.0+[/b]
[*]Download this mod and extract it to your Mods folder
[/list][code]%AppData%\StardewValley\Mods\
[/code][list]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley via SMAPI
[/list]
[list]
[/list]
